bias.zh: 偏空 · 落在 200 日均线上

read.en: Sandisk fell 1.8% on Oct 23 to $1,238.03, trading between $1,228.89 and $1,299.99. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,322.7), 10-day ($1,368.1), 30-day ($1,587.7) and 100-day ($1,626.4) averages, and just above the rising 200-day ($1,236.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,446.09), and RSI is 30.

The close broke the $1,244.6 Oct 22 low, now resistance, and sits on the 200-day ($1,236.3); the low reached $1,228.9. Resistance is $1,244.6, then $1,276–1,300 (Oct 15 low, Oct 23 high) and $1,322.7–1,325 (5-day, Jul 17 low). Support is $1,228.9–1,236.3 (Oct 23 low, 200-day), then $998 (Jul 29 low). A close above $1,277 would target $1,323; a close below $1,228 would open the $1,000 area.
